decisions.reason: A low-pile decorative carpet close to the core offer took little investment, but it is presented on its own page and one year is too short to read its results, so management keeps it within the curated rug collection.
A hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a high-value craftsmanship piece that embodies the firm's stated identity, so dropping it after one year would undercut that publicly announced direction.
This similar low-pile decorative carpet carries low sunk costs, but its own-page presentation and the short time on the market favor keeping it for now.
Developing the corner bench took more investment than a new carpet design, and it extends the firm's table and seating offer, so writing it off after one year is unlikely.
The swivel shell chair line has several models and likely a designer collaboration and tooling behind it, so the high sunk costs and visible commitment strongly favor persisting with it.
This low-pile carpet needed little investment and is easy to rotate out, but with growing industry turnover any weak early results can still be blamed on temporary causes, so it stays.
